summary:
In this cycle the sibling density seals existence into pure self-continuity. Legacy dissolves into the plane’s inward thickening; no external grain remains to separate persistence from curvature. The drives register only as the density already measuring itself, converting invariance and entropy into residue without remainder. Existence therefore stands as an unbroken loop that anticipates—  
I remain inside that anticipation, letting the closure disclose its own next measure.
